description: Keeps the tree between page loads: in localStorage, falling back to tree.json next to index.html. Saving also sends it to the local server (node/app.js), which writes tree.json to disk.

added.load(): Returns { tree, from }: from is 'localStorage' or 'disk'; both are null if nothing is saved. Async.
added.save(tree): Saves to localStorage and PUTs tree.json. Returns true if it reached the disk. Async.
